_comment: Committed lock for both test262 runners. corpus must match PINNED_COMMIT. language/builtins are pass-count floors. negAcceptExact is the exact accepted-negative count and must match test262-neg-accepts.json; the language runner also compares every path, so one-for-one swaps fail. Refresh only for a corpus bump or reviewed parser change. fix/wrong-values-2 (2026-08-27): refreshed both floors; Fail:0 confirmed on both runners. language DROPS 3003->2976 (not a straight trade of the 29 WRONG-VALUE closures; see below): closing comma/instanceof/break/continue's root cause (src/compile/emit.js's bare-identifier-read fallback, which used to blindly guess `local.get $name` for ANY unresolved name; silently correct only when the guess's value went unused and dead-code elimination happened to drop it) now rejects an unresolved read UNCONDITIONALLY. A reachability gate was added on top (src/compile/emit.js: emitBlockBody's statement loop AND the ';' statement-list emitter both now stop walking a list once isTerminator() proves an unconditional return/throw/break/continue precedes; src/type.js's existing predicate, reused not reinvented) so code textually after such a statement, which real JS never evaluates either, is skipped instead of wrongly rejected; this alone recovered part of the initial 29-test drop (2974->2976). Two DEEPER, narrower classes of unreachability remain unrecovered, confirmed via a baseline-worktree A/B diff (not a guess): (1) an if/while CONDITION expression that unconditionally throws before yielding true/false (test262 Sputnik idiom: `if ((function(){throw 1})()) abracadabra`; S12.5_A3.js, S12.6.2_A9.js, S12.6.1_A9.js and siblings), proving THIS needs general 'does this expression subtree always throw' analysis, not a statement-list scan; (2) sloppy-mode assignment to an undeclared name (S13_A15_T3.js's `THE_ANSWER="..."` top-level bare assignment, later read); jz has NO general implicit-global write-legalization (a pre-existing, deliberately-scoped-out gap; src/prepare/index.js's for-in target-binder carries its own comment explaining why a GENERAL version was never built: it would also have to loosen undeclared READS, which the whole point of this fix line keeps closed); these files passed in baseline only via the SAME accidental drop-the-guessed-read mechanism as the fixed entries, never on a sound basis. Both are out of reach in the time available without risking a repeat of this same pass's own 'u+' regression (see src/compile/emit.js's own comment on that revert); named and left, not silently reduced. Fail:0 is the load-bearing invariant, not the raw pass count, per STABILITY.md's own priority ("any unlisted silent wrong value is release-blocking"). builtins RISES 853->858 (unaffected by the reachability gate; several ToPrimitive/reflection fixes landing exact, zero regressions, Fail:0 before and after). fix/parser-residuals (2026-08-29): negAcceptExact 137->95 across several early-error additions (see test262-neg-accepts.json families and STABILITY.md's residual count); language/builtins floors untouched (rejection-only changes, verified Fail:0 and Pass unchanged at 2976/858 before and after each addition).
